## Houlihan Lokey Further Strengthens Equity Capital Solutions Capabilities With Senior Hire


November 23, 2026


**Kyle MacRae Joins as a Managing Director in New York**


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Kyle MacRae has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Based in New York, Mr. MacRae will focus on GP-led secondaries advisory for the firm.


Mr. MacRae joins the firm from Baird, where he was most recently a senior member of its GP Solutions Group, focusing on continuation vehicles and other GP-led transactions. Prior experience includes time in the GP-led secondaries advisory unit of the Private Funds Group at Credit Suisse.


“Kyle’s background in GP-led secondaries and his insight into the sector will enhance our ability to deliver exceptional outcomes to our clients,” said Gregg Newman, Global Co-Head of Capital Solutions at Houlihan Lokey. “We continue to attract premier talent to the platform as we seek to respond to client needs and build a market-leading secondaries practice. We are thrilled to welcome him to the firm.”


“The GP-led continuation vehicle has become an increasingly critical AUM and LP-liquidity tool for our clients, as the secondaries market depth has grown and pricing has become more competitive,” said Matt Swain, Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Solutions. “As this market continues to grow and evolve, Kyle’s deep transaction expertise will be valuable as we continue to deliver world-class, tailored solutions for our financial sponsor clients globally.”


Mr. MacRae added, “The scale and depth of Houlihan Lokey’s Capital Solutions Group are truly unmatched across all areas of private markets. I am thrilled to join a team that combines these market-leading product capabilities with deep industry expertise from its leading M&A practices to deliver a highly integrated and differentiated execution model and produce outlier results for our GP clients.”


Houlihan Lokey’s Capital Solutions Group comprises more than 240 dedicated professionals across 18 offices in eight countries, including Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Dubai, Frankfurt, Houston, London, Los Angeles, Madrid, Manchester, Milan, Munich, New York, Paris, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., West Palm Beach, and Zurich. In the past 12 months, the group raised and advised on $42 billion across more than 140 transactions.*


**As of September 30, 2026.*


**About Houlihan Lokey**


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
